audit_run.scope: EPILOGUE: THE OWNER OF THE BOUNDARY

amendment_run_a01.amendment_reason: Precision corrections to Epilogue epistemic claims (no Geneva/Seoul recurrence, later Pacific disturbances ordinary but original event unresolved, no destructive front observed approaching Earth, persistence of A-173 and PTA residuals), classification of Ian rationalization ladder as semantic summary, and exact text protection for terminal declaration.

scene.title: Opening
scene.terminal_asset: “I must control it.” (Exact Text Protected Asset / Terminal Line of Book 1)
scene.focus: Ian's personal rationalization ladder leading to the terrifying commitment to control the boundary.

chapter_gate.local_question: 인간이 국소적 bounded control의 가능성을 입증한 뒤, 누가 target state와 boundary의 안팎을 결정할 권리를 가져야 하는가?
chapter_gate.larger_question: Ian이 정당한 책임감을 더 큰 통제권의 근거로 바꾸었을 때, 그 권력은 Book II에서 누구를 보호하고 누구를 배제하게 되는가?
